sloka: ते तु रामेण सामर्षाः शूल पट्टिस पाणयः ।समरे निहताः सर्वे सायकैः मर्म भेदिभिः ॥३-२१-९॥
transliteration: te tu rāmeṇa sāmarṣāḥ śūla paṭṭisa pāṇayaḥ ।samare nihatāḥ sarve sāyakaiḥ marma bhedibhiḥ ॥3-21-9॥

translations.english: The demons who went with spears in their hands were killed, their hearts pierced by Rama's arrows.
